selected_memories.text: When FEN-62 encounters ZIR-66, the validated terminal code becomes ZUM-11.
Unverified rumor claims the terminal code associated with ZIR-66 is LOQ-42.

When GOL-56 encounters VOR-32, the validated terminal code becomes MUR-19.
